P1.1.text: The Ensign Group, Inc. – Skilled Nursing, Rehabilitation Therapy, Healthcare – San Juan Capistrano, CA

P1.2.text: Ensign’s independent operating affiliates provide personalized post-acute and long-term care services guided by local leadership and delivered by clinicians committed to helping residents heal, regain independence, and thrive.

P1.3.text: Commitment to quality Find care near you

P1.4.text: At the heart of our organization are hundreds of dedicated affiliates who enrich the lives of thousands of residents each year through exceptional care and genuine human connection.

P1.5.text: Through Moments of Truth, we will dignify post-acute care in the eyes of the world.

P1.6.text: Ensign Affiliates Provide Care That Counts

P1.8.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services through a unique ONE CLINICAL approach.

P1.9.text: This collaborative model brings an interdisciplinary team together at each location to deliver individualized, resident-centered care. By combining clinical excellence, exceptional service, and data-driven decision-making, the ONE CLINICAL teams help residents achieve better outcomes and live life to the fullest.

P1.10.text: Of Ensign-affiliated skilled nursing operations earned a CMS Quality Measure rating of 4 or 5 stars.*

P1.11.text: Better rehospitalization rates than the national average. Clinical teams work proactively to identify changes in condition early, intervene quickly, and help residents heal safely in place whenever possible.**

P1.12.text: * Data from CMS Care Compare, Five-Star Quality Rating System, as of ** Percentage as compared to same facilities. CMS Care Compare Data as of

P2.1.text: Care Services – The Ensign Group, Inc.

P2.2.text: Ensign affiliates provide skilled nursing, rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living services that leverage a ONE CLINICAL collaborative model of care focused on enhancing the lives of those they serve.

P2.4.text: At Ensign-affiliated locations, exceptional care begins with collaboration. Through a ONE CLINICAL approach, nurses, therapists, physicians, and interdisciplinary care teams work together to provide coordinated, personalized care that supports each resident’s unique needs. This collaborative model helps each resident benefit from a seamless, individualized care experience designed to maximize that individual resident’s health and wellness.

P2.5.text: Care Designed Around the Whole Person

P2.6.text: Rather than treating individual conditions in isolation, Ensign-affiliated teams take a comprehensive view of residents’ health. By combining clinical expertise, compassionate caregiving, and evidence-based practices, residents obtain the support they need to recover from illness, regain function, maintain independence, and achieve their highest possible quality of life.

P2.7.text: Driven by Data. Focused on Outcomes.

P2.8.text: The ONE CLINICAL approach is guided by clinical data and continuous improvement principles. Care teams monitor key quality measures and resident outcomes to identify risks early, evaluate progress, and develop targeted interventions that support better health and recovery. This commitment to measurement and accountability helps drive stronger outcomes while supporting overall quality of care and promoting regulatory excellence.

P3.2.text: Our affiliated locations are led by local teams who independently make decisions and create exceptional experiences for those they serve.

P3.3.text: Ensign-affiliated entities operate across 18 states, and the footprint continues with a purpose: to extend the mission of local leadership, clinical excellence, and compassionate care to more communities. This growth has enabled local leaders and their interdisciplinary care teams to innovate and invest in best-practice solutions to continuously improve the quality of care they provide. As the number of affiliates increases, more residents, patients, and families have access to this unique, locally led model of care.

P1.9.text: When you choose Aveanna, you are choosing more than a company. You are choosing a true national leader in home healthcare. No care feels more like home, because no company is more dedicated to bringing exceptional and innovative care into your home, wherever that home may be.

P1.12.text: We consider it both a privilege and an honor when we welcome a new patient into our Aveanna family. Our home health care is always delivered from a place of heartfelt compassion and empathy, and everyone on the Aveanna team works together to make sure we exceed your expectations.

P1.13.text: As a leader in caring, we are also a leader in hiring. We have opportunities in nursing, therapy, and all jobs in between. At Aveanna, you won’t just make a difference in our patients’ lives. You will make a difference in your own life.
